taxonomy_classification.classification_basis: Current-taxonomy review against VIGIL Failure Taxonomy 0.6.5 retains the occurrence as unclassified. VIGIL-FC-000038 Required Control Non-Activation was tested because the union alleges that AI-enabled layoffs occurred despite negotiated AI safeguards, but the underlying contractual control, its exact trigger, applicability and the asserted breach are not preserved sufficiently to establish a defined available control that failed to activate. VIGIL-FC-000041 Required Governance Route Bypass is likewise not established because no required review or approval route is evidenced as having been bypassed. VIGIL-FC-000046 Inferential Evidence–Authority Conflation is not established because the technical role of AI in the employment decision remains materially disputed and the record does not show an AI inference being treated as independent authority for the layoffs.
